text.p: Maverick Tube Corp said its board set a two-for-one stock split in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend to all shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 12.

Each holder of Maverick common stock entitled to the stock dividend will receive one additional share of the company's common stock for every one share of common stock held on the record date, said the maker of industrial tubing.
It said it anticipates the additional shares resulting from the dividend will be distributed about August 21.
Upon distribution, the number of outstanding shares will be doubled and it is expected that the share price will be reduced proportionately, Maverick said.
